finding.details: V47 froze only product preimage blobs but dynamically imported the Agent materializer/toolchain from the checkout. Agent materializer bytes changed while the three product preimages remained unchanged, so an old V47 PASS would not identify which transformation toolchain produced the composed bytes.
finding.risk: A final native-Windows gate could be attributed to the correct product preimages but a different Agent composition toolchain, weakening exact-source provenance and making an old composed PASS non-reproducible.

candidate.behavior: Before importing the Agent materializer, verify exact Git blob SHA for all five transformation helpers, then verify the three product preimages, compose current Agent wiring, apply V41/V45, compile all composed files, and print exact resulting Git blobs. --apply remains disposable-checkout only.

not_yet_proven: V48 exact composed output blobs on a full checkout
current Agent test cluster on V48 composed bytes
